## Message

```
[X18N4008] Invalid edit input <detail>
├▶ fix: Check the input shape against the docs.
╰▶ see: https://x18n.antfu.dev/errors/x18n4008
```

The CLI prints the code and why the error happened, with details such as a file name or a field. The fix and a link to this page follow. With `--json`, the same parts are in `errors` of the [envelope](/references/json-contracts).

## What to do

The input of an edit has the wrong shape.

- `x18n set` needs `--value <text>` (or `--value -` to read stdin).
- `x18n apply` needs JSON in the shape `{ "<locale>": { "<key>": "<value>" } }`. Values are strings, numbers, booleans or `null`.
- `x18n extract --apply` needs a plan file written by `x18n extract --plan`.
- `x18n review` needs `--locale <locale>` to comment, approve, request a change or suggest; `request-change` needs `--text` and `suggest` needs `--value`.

## Exit code

The CLI exits with code `1`.
